name: getunwind
description: The getunwind() system call copies the kernel’s call frame unwind data into the buffer pointed to by buf and returns the size of the unwind data. It is specific to IA-64 architecture and describes the gate page.

parameters.name: buf
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer where the unwind data is copied; data is only copied if buf_size is sufficient

parameters.name: buf_size
parameters.description: Size of the buffer; if greater than or equal to the unwind data size, data is copied; otherwise, no data is copied

return_value.success: Returns the size of the unwind data
return_value.failure: Returns -1 and sets errno to indicate the error

errors.description: The unwind info can’t be stored in the space specified by buf

bugs: This system call is obsolete and deprecated; the modern way to obtain the kernel’s unwind data is via vdso(7).
